about:
Fieldnotes shares first-hand stories from community projects, written by the people running them.

sayings.title: Community – Creating Impact
sayings.text: Come join us in creating smiles and moments that kids will remember. Stand with us, feel proud, and together we will change lives, one project at a time.

sayings.title: Small Steps – Big Smiles
sayings.text: Every smile we help create starts with someone like you. Give an hour, share a story or lend a hand, and watch a small moment grow into something big.

sayings.title: Beyond the Lanes – Into Lives
sayings.text: Kids remember the day someone showed up for them. Join us in making those days happen, and feel proud of the moments you helped create.

sayings.title: Together – Real Change
sayings.text: Together we turn good intentions into real change. A classroom stocked, a family supported, a child laughing again. Come be part of it.

sayings.title: Community – Stronger Together
sayings.text: No act of kindness is too small. When we come together as a community, every effort adds up to lives changed and smiles that last.

follow.title: Smiles You Created
follow.text: See the smiles your kindness made possible. We'll share each new one with you as it happens.

follow.title: Memories You Created
follow.text: The days kids never forget begin with people like you. Get the stories as they unfold.

follow.title: Stay in the Loop
follow.text: Be the first to hear when a new project starts or a story is shared.

follow.title: Walk With Us
follow.text: Get our project news and the smiles you helped create, straight to your inbox.

follow.title: Join the Community
follow.text: One email when something good happens. No spam, ever.

follow.title: Never Miss a Smile
follow.text: New projects, new stories, new moments. We'll let you know.

follow.title: Be Part of the Story
follow.text: Follow along as ideas become action and action becomes impact.

volunteer.title: Give an Hour
volunteer.text: One hour of your time can make a child's whole day. Come help at an event and see it for yourself.

volunteer.title: Share a Skill
volunteer.text: Coaching, cooking, driving, organizing, taking photos. Whatever you're good at, we have a place for it.

volunteer.title: Bring a Friend
volunteer.text: Volunteering is better together. Bring a friend, a family member or your whole team.

volunteer.title: Lead an Activity
volunteer.text: Run a game, host a bowling lane or guide a group of kids. We'll show you how.

volunteer.title: Join the Family
volunteer.text: Our volunteers come back because of the smiles. Join once and you'll understand why.
